lines.zh: 冰霜步履声，嘎吱嘎吱响。

lines.en: Step lightly in the cold wind.
Moving steadily in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 它踏过冰晶雪原的薄霜。
lines.en: It crunches over the frost of the ice-crystal plains.

lines.zh: 每一步都压碎一层冰壳。
lines.en: Every step breaks a shell of ice.

lines.zh: 冰甲碎裂，我的寒霜之心受创！
lines.en: Frost armor shattered, my ice heart is injured!
The cold wind has frostbitten me!

lines.zh: 被雪崩掩埋，我受困于雪中！
lines.en: Buried by the avalanche, I'm trapped in the snow!
Frost shards pierce me, the pain is excruciating!
I'm nearly frozen solid by the cold!
I'm trapped by ice, unable to move!
The ice of the tundra wounds me deeply!

lines.zh: 被冰雪封冻，我动弹不得！
lines.en: Frozen by ice, I can't move!

lines.zh: 看着你，寒冰在我心中沸腾！
lines.en: Looking at you, the ice in my heart boils.
Get closer, and you'll feel the chill.

lines.zh: 霜华在我的触碰下融化！
lines.en: The frost melts under my touch.

lines.zh: 寒冷是我们的共同语言！
在这冰原上，你是我的猎物！
lines.en: In this icy plain, you're my prey.

lines.zh: 寒冰与我同在，你逃不掉！
lines.en: Ice is with me, you can't escape.
Feel the power of the frost.

lines.zh: 寒冰重击，粉碎你的身体！

lines.en: I use the power of ice to defeat you.

lines.zh: 寒风中的碰撞，致命的交锋！
lines.en: Collisions in the cold wind, deadly clashes.

lines.zh: 寒冰之刃，切割你的生命！
冰之重击，冻结你的灵魂！
寒霜巨兽，撞击你的世界！
寒冰的力量，击垮你的意志！
lines.en: The power of ice, break your will.

lines.zh: 寒风中的碰撞，无尽的战斗！
lines.en: Collisions in the cold wind, endless battles.

lines.zh: 冰封之拳，粉碎你的防线！

lines.en: Be my companion, ice plain friend.

lines.zh: 寒冰之吻，冻住你的灵魂！

lines.en: Hastreus, dance on the ice plains.
Ice plains song, dance with frost.
Be with me, ice plains eternal.

lines.zh: 寒冰让我的攻击更致命！
冰霜巨兽的呼吸，冻住了你的脚。
lines.en: The frost beast's breath has your feet frozen.

lines.zh: 它从雪坡上抬起巨大的头。
lines.en: It lifts its huge head from the snowbank.
The snow mist parts and it sees you.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向喷出一口白气。
lines.en: It huffs a plume of white breath your way.

lines.zh: 它把身体转向你的脚印。
lines.en: It turns its bulk toward your tracks.

lines.zh: 冰雪里，它的鼻子抽动了两下。
lines.en: In the snow its nostrils twitch twice.

lines.zh: 它开始一步一步压过来。
lines.en: It begins to bear down on you, step by step.

lines.zh: 寒冰让我的攻击更准确！
它低头，冰角对准你的方向。
lines.en: It lowers its head, ice horns aimed at you.
Its forehoof paws the snow aside.

lines.zh: 它呼出的白气裹住了你。
lines.en: Its white breath wraps around you.
It packs the snow underfoot to ice.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地侧移，堵住你的退路。
lines.en: It sidles slowly across your retreat.

lines.zh: 它的冰甲在冷光里发亮。
lines.en: Its ice armor gleams in the cold light.
It shifts its weight onto its forelegs.

lines.zh: 它一次只逼近半步，却不停。
lines.en: It closes only half a step at a time, but never stops.

lines.zh: 它身上的霜屑簌簌落下来。
lines.en: Frost flakes sift down off its hide.
It waits for you to start shivering.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片在我脚下裂开！

lines.en: Your attacks are like a candle in the wind!
Frost has already seeped into your bones!
I never fall in the cold wind!

lines.zh: 你的刀片在我皮上划过！
lines.en: Your blade skims over my skin!
The frozen world is my domain!

lines.zh: 它的冰角挑开你的护甲。
lines.en: Its ice horn peels your armor open.
It charges head-first in a blast of cold.

lines.zh: 它的前蹄砸下来，地面结冰。
lines.en: Its hoof slams down and the ground freezes.
One shove buries you in a drift.

lines.zh: 它的肩撞让雪坡塌了一角。
lines.en: Its shoulder takes a corner off the snowbank.

lines.zh: 它甩头，冰屑扎进你皮肤。
lines.en: It tosses its head and ice shards bite your skin.
It grinds you against the ice sheet.

lines.zh: 它的寒气顺着伤口渗进来。
lines.en: Its cold seeps in through the wound.
After the hit it exhales a cloud of white.

lines.zh: 冰晶雪原回响着它的踏声。
lines.en: The ice plains echo with its stamping.

lines.zh: 冰晶雪原的雪面鼓起一块。
lines.en: The snow surface of the ice plains bulges.

lines.zh: 风雪里多了一座移动的冰山。
lines.en: A moving iceberg joins the blizzard.
Fire! My ice armor is melting!

lines.zh: 坠落冰雪间，火焰侵蚀我！
lines.en: Burned by flames from the fall!

lines.zh: 冰雪爆炸，冲击波刺痛我！

lines.en: Magical ice binds me, cold like a blade!
